persons.name: Dadhīca Bāpū
persons.evidence: idaṃ pustakaṃ dadhī ca vāpū jośī yāce aśe

notes: The catalogue gives VS 1925, but the quoted colophon reads saṃvat 1915. VS 1915 − 57 = 1858, but Māgha śukla 6 of that year (Caitrādi) falls in Jan/Feb 1859 CE. The ownership statement is in Marathi ('yāce aśe', i.e. 'yāce āhe', meaning 'belongs to'), so the date is only a terminus for the ownership note if that note was added later. The cataloguer writes the name as 'dadhī ca', which probably stands for one word, Dadhīca/Dādhīca. This could be a family name or the Dādhīca brahmin community name qualifying Bāpū Jośī, in which case the personal name would be just Bāpū. 'vāpū' is read as Bāpū (v/b).
